differences: Table 1, vowel /u/ F1: the t statistic is 3.6725 here and 3.672 in the paper (rounding to three decimals gives 3.673); every other mean, SE, d, t and Holm-corrected p in Table 1 agrees with the printed decimals.

Vowel duration: the means of the per-phase medians reproduce (449 and 365 ms), the paper's +-2.1 and +-1.3 ms do not match an SE across participants and words (7.8 and 4.8 ms here); the paper does not say what they are.
